spec.name: Blend v9
spec.notes: Multi-factor score: momentum, drift and low risk.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.7, annual return 7%, maximum drawdown 6%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation, raising concerns about overfitting. While the claimed performance metrics (Sharpe 1.7, 7% annual return, 6% max drawdown) appear reasonable, the lack of robustness testing and the inclusion of transaction costs in the backtest warrant caution. Paper trading is recommended to assess the strategy's performance on unseen data and with realistic cost considerations before deploying real capital.
